summary.zh: 状语从句（Adverbial Clauses）是在句中充当状语的从句，用来说明主句动作发生的时间、原因、条件、让步、目的、结果、方式、地点或比较关系。它通常由 subordinating conjunctions（从属连词）引导，例如 because, although, if, when, while, since, unless, so that, whereas 等。在 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 写作、口语及阅读中，状语从句能够帮助考生表达复杂逻辑关系，提高句子多样性和语法复杂度，但也容易出现逗号使用错误、时态错误、主从句逻辑不清以及中式直译等问题。

structure.formula: Subordinating conjunction + subject + verb, main clause / Main clause + subordinating conjunction + subject + verb
structure.explanation: 状语从句由从属连词引导，不能单独构成完整句子，必须依附于主句。若状语从句放在句首，通常要在从句后加逗号；若放在句末，通常不需要逗号，除非表示明显对比或补充说明。状语从句的核心功能不是补充名词，而是说明整个主句动作的背景、原因、条件或逻辑关系。例如，在 academic writing 中，考生可以用 although 引导让步从句，用 because 或 since 引导原因从句，用 if 或 unless 引导条件从句，用 so that 引导目的从句，从而构建更清晰的 argument structure。

examples.en: Although the policy was controversial, it significantly reduced urban congestion.
examples.zh: 尽管这项政策存在争议，但它显著减少了城市拥堵。

examples.en: Many students improve their fluency when they practise speaking under timed conditions.
examples.zh: 当学生在限时条件下练习口语时，他们的流利度通常会提高。

examples.en: The government should invest in public transport because private car use is increasing rapidly.
examples.zh: 政府应该投资公共交通，因为私家车使用正在迅速增加。

usage_scenarios.title: 时间状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 时间状语从句说明主句动作发生的时间，常用 when, while, before, after, as soon as, once, until, since 等引导。在学术表达中，它常用于描述趋势、过程、研究步骤或政策实施后的变化。注意：在表示将来时间时，时间状语从句通常使用一般现在时，而不是 will。

examples.en: Once the data are collected, researchers can identify long-term patterns.
examples.zh: 一旦数据被收集，研究人员就可以识别长期规律。

examples.en: When children are exposed to a second language early, they tend to develop better pronunciation.
examples.zh: 当儿童较早接触第二语言时，他们往往会形成更好的发音。

usage_scenarios.title: 原因状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 原因状语从句解释主句发生的原因，常由 because, since, as, now that 引导。在 IELTS Task 2 和 PTE Write Essay 中，原因状语从句常用于支持观点或解释社会现象。because 语气最直接，since 和 as 更偏正式，适合学术写作。

examples.en: Since online education offers greater flexibility, it has become increasingly popular among working adults.
examples.zh: 由于在线教育提供更大的灵活性，它在职场成年人中变得越来越受欢迎。

examples.en: Public libraries remain important because they provide equal access to information.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆仍然重要，因为它们提供平等获取信息的机会。

usage_scenarios.title: 条件状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 条件状语从句表示某事发生的前提，常用 if, unless, provided that, as long as, in case 等引导。考试写作中，条件状语从句常用于提出政策建议、预测结果或讨论解决方案。unless 表示 if not，中文常译为“除非”。

examples.en: If governments fail to regulate pollution, public health costs will continue to rise.
examples.zh: 如果政府未能监管污染，公共健康成本将继续上升。

examples.en: Students can make steady progress as long as they receive consistent feedback.
examples.zh: 只要学生获得持续反馈，他们就能取得稳定进步。

usage_scenarios.title: 让步状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 让步状语从句表示主句内容与预期相反，常由 although, though, even though, while, whereas, despite the fact that 引导。它适合用于 balanced argument，即在承认相反观点后提出自己的立场。注意 although 和 but 通常不要在同一句中同时连接同一组主从关系。

examples.en: Although technology has improved workplace efficiency, it has also increased employees' stress levels.
examples.zh: 尽管科技提高了工作场所的效率，但它也增加了员工的压力水平。

examples.en: While private schools may offer better facilities, they can widen educational inequality.
examples.zh: 虽然私立学校可能提供更好的设施，但它们可能扩大教育不平等。

usage_scenarios.title: 目的状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 目的状语从句说明主句动作的目的，常用 so that, in order that 引导。口语和写作中也常使用 so that，而 in order that 更正式但使用频率较低。目的状语从句中常出现 can, could, may, might 等情态动词。

examples.en: Schools should provide career guidance so that students can make informed decisions.
examples.zh: 学校应该提供职业指导，以便学生能够做出知情决定。

examples.en: The experiment was repeated in order that the results might be verified.
examples.zh: 该实验被重复进行，以便结果能够得到验证。

usage_scenarios.title: 结果状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 结果状语从句说明主句造成的结果，常见结构包括 so...that 和 such...that。so 后通常接形容词或副词，such 后通常接名词短语。在 PTE 写作中，这类结构可用于强化因果关系，但应避免过度夸张。

examples.en: The cost of housing has risen so sharply that many young people cannot afford to buy a home.
examples.zh: 住房成本上涨得如此迅速，以至于许多年轻人买不起房。

examples.en: It was such a comprehensive report that policymakers used it as a reference.
examples.zh: 这是一份如此全面的报告，以至于政策制定者将其作为参考。

usage_scenarios.title: 比较与方式状语从句
usage_scenarios.description: 比较状语从句常由 than, as...as 引导，用于比较程度或数量；方式状语从句常由 as, as if, as though 引导，用于说明动作方式。在学术表达中，比较状语从句常用于分析不同群体、国家、方法或趋势之间的差异。

examples.en: Urban residents tend to use public services more frequently than rural residents do.
examples.zh: 城市居民往往比农村居民更频繁地使用公共服务。

examples.en: The manager responded as if the problem had already been solved.
examples.zh: 经理的回应好像这个问题已经被解决了一样。

common_mistakes.wrong: Although public transport is convenient, but many people still prefer driving.
common_mistakes.correct: Although public transport is convenient, many people still prefer driving.
common_mistakes.explanation: although 已经表示“虽然”，不能再用 but 连接同一个主句。中文常说“虽然……但是……”，但英文中通常使用 Although + 从句, 主句。

common_mistakes.wrong: When the government will introduce stricter laws, pollution will decrease.
common_mistakes.correct: When the government introduces stricter laws, pollution will decrease.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在时间状语从句中表示将来，通常用一般现在时，而不是 will。主句可以用 will 表示将来结果。

common_mistakes.wrong: Because many people work from home. Traffic congestion has decreased.
common_mistakes.correct: Because many people work from home, traffic congestion has decreased.
common_mistakes.explanation: because 引导的是从属从句，不能单独作为完整句子使用。应与主句连接，形成完整的 complex sentence。

common_mistakes.wrong: Unless the government does not invest in education, inequality will increase.
common_mistakes.correct: Unless the government invests in education, inequality will increase.
common_mistakes.explanation: unless 本身表示 if not，因此一般不再加 not。该句意思是“除非政府投资教育，否则不平等会增加”。

common_mistakes.wrong: The policy was effective because reducing unemployment.
common_mistakes.correct: The policy was effective because it reduced unemployment.
common_mistakes.explanation: because 后面通常接完整从句，即 subject + verb。如果后面接名词或动名词短语，应使用 because of，例如 because of its impact on unemployment。

common_mistakes.wrong: So many people use smartphones, they communicate less face to face.
common_mistakes.correct: Because so many people use smartphones, they communicate less face to face.
common_mistakes.explanation: 中文中的“所以”容易被直译为 so 放在句首，但英文中不能用 so many people... 直接表达原因并用逗号连接两个完整句。应使用 because, since 或 as 引导原因状语从句。

common_mistakes.wrong: If students will practise regularly, they will improve their pronunciation.
common_mistakes.correct: If students practise regularly, they will improve their pronunciation.
common_mistakes.explanation: 真实条件句中，if 条件从句通常用一般现在时表示将来条件，主句使用 will 表示结果。

common_mistakes.wrong: The city is more crowded as before.
common_mistakes.correct: The city is more crowded than before.
common_mistakes.explanation: 比较级通常与 than 搭配，而不是 as。as...as 用于同级比较，例如 as crowded as before。

pte_usage.description: 状语从句在 PTE Academic 中属于高频语法点，尤其常见于 Write Essay, Summarize Written Text, Summarize Spoken Text, Re-tell Lecture 和 Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks。使用状语从句可以提升句子复杂度和逻辑连贯性，但必须保证主从句结构完整、连接词准确、时态一致。在 PTE 写作评分中，恰当使用原因、让步和条件状语从句有助于提高 grammar range 和 written discourse；在口语任务中，使用 although, because, when, if 等连接词可以让答案更有层次，避免简单句堆砌。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.translation: 尽管……，但是……。用于承认相反观点后提出主要论点。
由于……，……。用于正式说明原因，适合学术写作。

academic_patterns.pattern: If + clause, + main clause with modal verb.
academic_patterns.translation: 如果……，就可能/应该/将会……。用于提出条件、预测结果或政策建议。
除非……，否则会产生负面结果。常用于强调必要措施。
虽然/然而……，……。用于对比两个观点、群体或趋势。
以便……能够……。用于说明目的。
如此……以至于……。用于表达结果或影响程度。

academic_patterns.pattern: As soon as + clause, + main clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 一……就……。用于描述时间顺序或即时反应。
只要/在……条件下，……。用于正式条件表达。
然而/而……。用于正式对比，常见于学术分析。

collocations.translation: 虽然这一观点是合理的

collocations.phrase: so that resources can be allocated efficiently
collocations.translation: 以便资源能够被高效分配

collocations.phrase: as long as safety standards are maintained
collocations.translation: 只要安全标准得到维持

collocations.phrase: even though the initial cost is high
whereas the former focuses on efficiency

ai_tips: 写作中优先掌握 although, because, if, when, while, so that 六类高频状语从句，它们覆盖大多数 PTE 和 IELTS 论证场景。
如果从句放在句首，通常使用逗号分隔；如果从句放在句末，通常不需要逗号。
检查每个状语从句是否有完整的 subject 和 verb，避免把 because, although, if 后面的内容写成残缺句。
PTE Write Essay 中不要为了追求复杂句而连续堆叠多个从句；一个主句搭配一个清晰的状语从句通常更安全。
表达让步时，不要受中文“虽然……但是……”影响写成 although...but；英文一般保留 although，删除 but。
条件和时间状语从句中表示将来时，优先检查是否误用了 will，例如 if students will learn 应改为 if students learn。
在 Summarize Written Text 中，状语从句适合压缩原文逻辑，例如用 although 表示转折，用 because 表示原因，用 while 表示对比。

practice_questions.question: 改错：Although online learning is convenient, but it may reduce face-to-face interaction.
practice_questions.answer: Although online learning is convenient, it may reduce face-to-face interaction. 解释：although 和 but 不应同时连接同一主从结构。

practice_questions.question: 用 because 合并句子：Many cities are investing in public transport. Traffic congestion has become a serious problem.
practice_questions.answer: Many cities are investing in public transport because traffic congestion has become a serious problem.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确形式：If the policy (will succeed / succeeds), more people will support it.
practice_questions.answer: succeeds。正确句子：If the policy succeeds, more people will support it. 条件状语从句中用一般现在时表示将来条件。

practice_questions.question: 将句子翻译成英文：尽管这项计划成本很高，但它可能带来长期收益。
practice_questions.answer: Although the project is costly, it may bring long-term benefits.

practice_questions.question: 用 so that 完成句子：Universities should provide academic support ______.
practice_questions.answer: Universities should provide academic support so that students can adapt to demanding coursework.

practice_questions.question: 改错：Because the population is ageing. Healthcare costs are increasing.
practice_questions.answer: Because the population is ageing, healthcare costs are increasing. 解释：because 从句不能单独成句，必须连接主句。

practice_questions.question: 用 unless 改写：If governments do not control emissions, environmental damage will worsen.
practice_questions.answer: Unless governments control emissions, environmental damage will worsen.

practice_questions.question: 选择合适连接词填空：______ some people believe tourism damages local culture, others argue that it creates jobs. 可选：Because / While / Unless
practice_questions.answer: While。正确句子：While some people believe tourism damages local culture, others argue that it creates jobs.

practice_questions.question: 用 so...that 翻译：这个问题如此复杂，以至于很难在短时间内解决。
practice_questions.answer: The problem is so complex that it is difficult to solve within a short period of time.

practice_questions.question: 判断并改正：When students will receive feedback, they will improve faster.
practice_questions.answer: 错误。应改为：When students receive feedback, they will improve faster. 时间状语从句中表示将来不用 will。
